_real_world.variant_scope: Arleigh Burke Flight IIA (DDG-91 and later; DDG-81/DDG-96 in this OOB).

_provenance.modeling_note: SPY-1D(V) volume-search radar for Flight IIA DDGs. Kept as a CSG-specific record (distinct from the repo's generic AN/SPY-1D_Volume_Search_MVP) because Flight IIA carries the -1D(V) variant, not the baseline -1D fitted to earlier flights/Flight II in this OOB. No admissible source distinguishes -1D(V)'s instrumented range from -1D's; the value is carried over unchanged from the repo's existing SPY-1D MVP calibration (itself community-derived/engineering calibration), scaled only by the smooth-earth horizon geometry difference from a slightly taller DDG mast estimate.

sensor.type.note: SPY-1D(V) is a radar; Radar is the only matching engine sensor type

sensor.max_range.note: SPY-1 air-search ~175 nmi (C-est, csg-us-spy1-wiki/csis); carried at the repo MVP's existing calibration value unchanged since no -1D vs -1D(V) delta is public

sensor.fov_deg.note: 4-face fixed phased array gives full 360-deg coverage; not a per-face FOV number since the engine models one merged radar

sensor.scan_period.note: no public scan-rate figure; carried unchanged from the repo's existing AN/SPY-1D_Volume_Search_MVP calibration

sensor.detection_prob.note: no public Pd figure; carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: no public bearing-accuracy figure; carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration

sensor.range_noise_std.note: no public range-accuracy figure; carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration

sensor.track_memory_s.note: no public track-coast figure; carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent (inverse-4th-power family); standard engine default for a search radar, not sourced per-platform

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling; carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP, consistent with the MVP's simplified surface-search detection model

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: no public MTI/doppler-notch figure; carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration

sensor.reference_snr_db.note: radar-equation calibration constant; carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP, paired with reference_range_m/reference_rcs_m2 to reproduce the MVP's max_range at a reference target

sensor.reference_range_m.note: paired radar-equation calibration constant, see reference_snr_db

sensor.reference_rcs_m2.note: 5 m^2 generic warship/large-aircraft reference RCS, engine convention also used across the repo's other naval radar records

sensor.antenna_height_m.note: DDG-51 mast height not public; reuses repo SPY-1D MVP mount-height proxy

sensor.target_height_bias_m.note: no public figure; carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration (horizon-geometry bias term)

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a shipborne air/surface search radar per authoring standard

sensor.sea_clutter_enabled.note: disabled, consistent with the MVP's simplified detection model; no sourced clutter-suppression figure exists to calibrate an enabled model

sensor.enable_ducting.note: standard engine atmospheric-ducting toggle, enabled consistent with repo SPY-1D MVP convention for a long-range search radar

sensor.ducting_gain_factor.note: carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration

sensor.ducting_max_bonus_m.note: carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration
